newsitem.title: EGYPT: Hawks "in mourning" close Cairo runway.
newsitem.headline: Hawks "in mourning" close Cairo runway.

text.p: A flock of hawks closed one of the runways at Cairo airport for 45 minutes on Sunday after a small plane killed one of their companions during takeoff.
The flock circled over the runway and dispersed only after the body of the dead hawk was removed, airport officials said.
The airport diverted planes to another runway and traffic was not disrupted, they said.
